netlist:
* Spicey Electrons circuit at 20 C
.options rshunt=1e12 reltol=1e-3 method=gear
.temp 20
vam_B1 n1 B1_am 0
V_B1 B1_int 0 PWL(0 0 1e-06 9)
R_B1_in B1_am B1_int 0.1
vam_SIG1 n2 SIG1_am 0
V_SIG1 SIG1_int 0 SIN(0 0.005 1000)
R_SIG1_in SIG1_am SIG1_int 0.1
vam_C1 n2 C1_am 0
C_C1 C1_am n3 1e-05
vam_R1 n1 R1_am 0
R_R1 R1_am n3 33000
vam_R2 n3 R2_am 0
R_R2 R2_am 0 10000
vam_R3 n1 R3_am 0
R_R3 R3_am n4 2200
vam_R4 n5 R4_am 0
R_R4 R4_am 0 470
vam_Q1 n4 Q1_am 0
vam_Q1_p0 n3 Q1_p0 0
vam_Q1_p2 n5 Q1_p2 0
Q_Q1 Q1_am Q1_p0 Q1_p2 2N3904
vam_C2 n5 C2_am 0
C_C2 C2_am 0 4.7e-05
.model 2N3904 NPN(IS=6.734f XTI=3 EG=1.11 VAF=74.03 BF=416.4 NE=1.259 ISE=6.734f IKF=66.78m XTB=1.5 BR=.7371 NC=2 ISC=0 IKR=0 RC=1 CJC=3.638p MJC=.3085 VJC=.75 FC=.5 CJE=4.493p MJE=.2593 VJE=.75 TR=239.5n TF=301.2p ITF=.4 VTF=4 XTF=2 RB=10)
.control
set filetype=binary
tran 1e-05 0.11 0.1 1e-05
write __OUT__ v(n1) v(n2) v(n3) v(n4) v(n5) i(vam_b1) i(vam_sig1) i(vam_c1) i(vam_r1) i(vam_r2) i(vam_r3) i(vam_r4) i(vam_q1) i(vam_c2) i(vam_q1_p0) i(vam_q1_p2)
quit
.endc
.end
